title: fold-check subcommand (r3-N11) has zero automated coverage — not wired into CI
evidence:
GATES=(
  "Purity + grep gates (ODN-1)|tools/lint.sh"
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|odin test core"
  "Game builds (app.bin compiles + links)|odin build app -out:app.bin"
  "Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)|tools/harness.sh run"
  "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck"
  "W1 drift-rejection negative test|tools/harness.sh drift-check"
  "Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim routing)|tools/harness.sh preview-check"
  "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug"
  "Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)|tools/harness.sh stats-check pause && tools/harness.sh stats-check qos_contention"
  "Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller + CLI arg-validation leg)|tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1"
)
detail: New subcommand with three exit paths (0/1/2), arg parsing, and the splice proof is invoked nowhere: not in the 10 gates, harness.sh, or .github. Dead from CI's view.
recommended_fix: Add a gate to ci-local.sh + the workflow: `./bin/harness fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` plus a usage-error negative leg (wrong arg count → exit 2).

title: usage() omits fold-check, so the wrong-arg path prints help that lacks the new verb
evidence: fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png]")
detail: When `fold-check` is invoked with wrong args, usage() (exit 2) lists every verb except fold-check, so the subcommand is undiscoverable from the harness's own error text.
recommended_fix: Append `| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` to the usage() string.

title: campus-half floor hardcodes literal 10 while the total ask is now catalog-derived
evidence:
EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
...
testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
	"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: N5 derives the total ask from catalog volumes × multiplier; the campus floor keeps a literal 10 (campus vol 1 × multiplier 10). A re-tune drifts EXPECTED but silently stales this floor.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor from the campus entry's volume × surge.multiplier, mirroring the N5 derivation, instead of the literal 10.

title: r3-B1 double-free fix has no automated regression detection (allocator masks it in-suite)
detail: Ownership transfer is sound (catalogs_destroy frees e3.entries once). But the exact bug class the fix removes is invisible to `odin test`, so a future double-free is silent.
recommended_fix: Add a non-`odin test` repro (standalone binary) that aborts on double-free and wire it into a CI gate, per the comment's 'standalone repro'.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (no critical-path gap; B1/W1/N3/N4/N5/N6 verified against core + all pins exercised by gate 2). P1 core pins (W1/N3/N4/N5/N6/N7) 100% covered; fold-check 0% wired. Overall ~75%: the headline N11 deliverable is a dead subcommand.
recommended_fix: Wire fold-check into ci-local.sh + workflow as a gate (pass + usage-error legs); then the fold discipline is actually enforced and the gate lifts to PASS.
